entry.name: string.substring
entry.digest: Generate a new string from a range of characters in an incoming string
entry.description: string.substring is similar to string.slice, but doesn't conform to the JavaScript String.slice() behavior.

arguments.name: substring-indexes
arguments.description: Set the range to extract when a string is received in the leftmost inlet. Negative values index from the end of the string, and a single value on its own implicitly stretches to the end of the string . If the end of the range is before the start, then the elements of the range will be reversed.
